Start the game

Customize your square face

What Is Square Face Generator?

Square Face Generator is a classic Flash avatar maker game where you can create funny square-shaped face icons. Mix different facial features, expressions, hairstyles, and accessories to design a unique square face character.

Runs in modern browsers with Ruffle
No Flash Player installation
Square Face Generator Features
Classic Flash Game

Play a nostalgic avatar maker from the Flash game era.

Square Face Avatar

Create funny square-shaped face characters.

No Flash Player Required

The game runs in modern browsers with a Flash emulator.

Free to Play

Play directly online without installing anything.

Simple Controls

Use the in-game options to customize your face.

Desktop Friendly

Best played on desktop or laptop browsers.

How to Play
1
Start the game

Wait for the Flash game to load in the player above, then press the START button inside the game.

2
Customize your square face

Use the in-game buttons to change the face, eyes, mouth, hair, colors, accessories, and other details.

3
Create your favorite look

Try different combinations until you make a funny or cute square face icon. If the original game does not include a save button, you can take a screenshot of your creation.

For the best experience, play Square Face Generator on a desktop browser. If the game area looks too small, use the fullscreen button. If the game does not respond, reload the game and try again.
